bounded_contexts.name: cloud-secrets
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud Secrets foundation for metadata-only OpenBao SecretReference handles, fail-closed bootstrap admission, zeroizing in-memory secret buffers, and metadata-only persistence seams. No live OpenBao, HSM, SLO, DR, sharding, SDK, REST runtime, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by CS-CLOUD-SECRETS-001.

naming_justifications: Cloud Secrets currently uses the existing oya-secrets-domain and oya-secrets-file-adapter crates as the single code-backed secrets substrate. The previous oya-cloud-secrets-* crate roster was removed from this manifest because none of those crates exists in the workspace.

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-SECRETS-001 is a pure domain/metadata foundation. Runtime OpenBao reads/writes, HSM ops, namespace controllers, measured capacity, autoscaling, and SLOs remain explicit non-claims.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Secret-management foundation touches secret-reference control contracts and bootstrap policy. Runtime deployment is not implemented yet; Tier-1 is retained as the intended isolation class for future Cloud Secrets runtime pods.
